description: Fetch the full lead field metadata list (id, displayName, name, dataType, length) for the configured Marketo instance's Lead Database schema.
embedding_description: Retrieve the Marketo Lead Database's own field schema/metadata catalog — every available lead field's API name, display name, and data type — for discovering what fields exist BEFORE building get_leads filters or create_or_update_leads payloads. This is schema discovery, not lead data itself; use get_leads to fetch actual lead records.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with records (a list of field descriptor dicts: id, displayName, name, dataType, length) + row_count + spilled=false inline, OR result_blob_key + row_count + spilled=true when the schema is large.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the row_count (field count) and list a handful of field names/types; point to result_blob_key for the full schema.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch the Marketo lead field schema.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.auth_failed: the OAuth credentials were rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks a required Access API permission (e.g. Read-Only Person). marketo.rate_limited: the instance's API rate limit was exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied: run check_setup to see the exact missing Role permission.
